name: 🔎Flow's Prop Hunt
desc:
🎮 CONSOLE SUPPORT ADDED! 🎮

🔍Welcome to Flow's Prop Hunt!🔎

🪄 Hider: Disguise yourself as any object around the map and blend in with the environment. Use your abilities to help stay alive and win the game. Stay hidden and survive until the time runs out!
🔪 Seeker: Hunt down all the players disguised as objects. Use your hammer to destroy objects and reveal any hiders.

Please leave a Like 👍 for more updates!

🪙 Collect coins to unlock taunt sounds, exclusive hammer skins, and helpful abilities!

🏷️ Tags: Prop Hunt, Hide and Seek, Tag, Sneak, Hide N Seek, Props, Disguise, Sneak, Stealth

Thank you for playing!
